title: Machine-learning protein design optimises broadly neutralizing sarbecovirus antibodies
summary: Structure-conditioned machine-learning protein design was used to optimise two broadly neutralizing sarbecovirus antibodies: one anti-RBD class 4 antibody to regain activity against Omicron variants, and one anti-S2 stem antibody to improve its neutralization profile. The lead candidates PRO-37587 and GB-0669 resisted SARS-CoV-2 evolution, and in combination improved neutralization in vitro and in vivo with a higher barrier to resistance, supported by structural analyses. Preprint; the abstract gives no numbers.
